statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities is needed
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service is to capture potential arrhythmic events
The patient has diagnosis code R55 (syncope)
The patient has diagnosis code I47.1 (supraventricular tachycardia)
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
SilverBridge Advantage requires pre-approval for such diagnostic monitoring services
